# AniStream v2.1.1

Smoother downloads and navigation, and a handful of fixes for small annoyances.

## Better

- ⚡️ Back takes you back: Starting a show, movie or manga straight from a card or the home page
  and then pressing **Back** returns you to where you were, not to the title page
- ⚡️ Downloading a season now asks in a clear pop-up that shows how many episodes, the quality
  and roughly how much space they need, with **Cancel** and **Download all**
- ⚡️ The season picker only shows when there is something to pick. Shows without other seasons,
  movies or specials no longer have an empty picker; long runners like One Piece keep theirs for
  their story arcs
- 💄 One **Back** button everywhere: the same round button in the same place on title pages,
  players and the manga reader

## Fixed

- 🦺 **Download all** for a season could not be reached because the menu was cut off
- 🦺 The **Up Next** menu on anime title pages could be cut off the same way
- 🦺 Pressing **Escape** to close a pop-up also closed the title page behind it
- 🦺 Letters like g, p and y were cut off at the bottom of titles on the Anime and Manga home pages
- 🦺 The **Back** button on movie and show pages was partly hidden

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.1.1-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.1.1.exe`: Windows x64

On Windows, AniStream downloads this update in the background and installs it when you choose
**Restart to update**. You can also install over your existing copy; your data and AniList session
are kept. macOS links to this release page.

Both packages are unsigned. On Windows, select **More info → Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns
you. On macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after the first
launch. Each download can be checked against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
